card.title: Confess First
card.instruction: Get someone else to confess or incriminate themselves before you reveal anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we plan Mum's apology dinner, why did she spend her birthday outside the restaurant?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I forgot the booking. What happened to her present?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did you forget, or assume I'd book it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I assumed you'd do it. Now your turn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even after telling Mum it was confirmed? Give me that bit, then you get the present.

mechanism: A delays their own gift explanation until B confesses the booking failure and its misleading assurance.
confusable: Unlike a shared review of mistakes, A must control the order to secure the other confession first.
comparison: D16-b escalates from forgetting to assuming to misinforming Mum; D16-a escalates from jam to labels to a printed prohibition.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
